hits.doc: a fast left jab with the clamp claw
the backhand: shorter windup, same reach; Rivet steps in 0.4 m (the jab's knockback) so it connects
the finisher: a lunging two-handed slam (0.5 m step in); knockback

doc: Rivet's bare-handed melee as timing data (rivet-motion, 2026-11-03 eve). Ticks are 60 Hz frames. A claw hit is windup -> active (the hit test runs on the first active tick) -> recovery. A press during a hit is buffered; the next hit starts at cancel_ticks into the recovery. After a hit ends, a press within combo_window_ticks continues the combo; later it restarts at hit 1. The live tuning panel edits these rows.

shock.doc: Hold melee to charge, release to discharge: stuns the target, then arcs to metal targets in range.
